host_boundary: T24 adds typed run_recall_benchmark with ExplicitRouteArgs plus optional k. deny_unknown_fields. Extra path/root is schema. Non-fixture routes are policy and do not open the library. k 0 or greater than 64 is schema. Default k is 20. The benchmark is BMDock-owned over FixtureLibrary: a small Chinese gold set (queries such as 欢迎) whose relevant permalinks are observed on physical UTF-8 files whose body contains the query. recall@k is computed from T21 search_notes hits. A hit counts only if the physical file contains the query. Missing relevant files are empty, not user-vault. The DTO records bounded in-process search_elapsed_ms and expand_elapsed_ms. semantic_enabled=false. engine_search=false. native_gui=false. Chinese permalinks such as 欢迎 remain in graph expansion and search hits; expansion/search do not drop CJK. Production EmptyLibrary returns recall with zero queries and classified_as empty, not user-vault success. Envelope text is not disk proof. Dual profiles stay isolated and are not mixed into the recall DTO. MCP identity search and call_tool stay denied. T24 does not start Supervisor, add rmcp, or run just contract as proof. just build stays the G0 probe.
